title: Dual Cargo profile: workspace `release` for hosts, `release-docker` for containers
description: Define a sibling Cargo profile that inherits `release` but disables LTO and bumps codegen-units. Container builds select it via Dockerfile ARG; host `cargo build --release` is unaffected. Trades ~10-15% runtime throughput for ~30% faster compile and ~50% lower peak rustc memory inside BuildKit, where the binary is throwaway anyway.
example:
[profile.release-docker]
inherits = "release"
lto = false
codegen-units = 16
incremental = false

# Dockerfile:
ARG PROFILE=release-docker
RUN xx-cargo build --profile $PROFILE ...
whenToUse: When workspace `release` profile uses LTO (thin or fat) and Docker builds OOM or take too long inside BuildKit
whenNotToUse: When the shipped binary needs peak runtime perf for hot loops the user calls (e.g. SIMD vector kernels). Document the trade in dockerhub README so consumers know.
